findings.detail: The issuer_name field captured row wrappers and adjacent schedule columns instead of only the clean Portfolio Company value.

rationale: C206 is a real data error. The raw SOI table presents issuer names as clean Portfolio Company cells, with investment type, dates, maturity, interest rate, principal, cost, fair value, and footnotes in separate columns. The flagged extracted issuer_name values concatenate those separate source fields and higher-level wrappers into one issuer field, proving an extraction/wrapper parse failure rather than a valid issuer name.
